R07.label: REAL DATA EXTRACTS WITH TRANSCRIBED REPORT TABLES
R07.construction: Parts A-B copy Elexon DCI and 5-minute demand summary records (hash-checked) without changing values. Part C transcribes ESO Table 6, the E3C interim Table 1 and quotes ESO sections 4.3/5.1 and Ofgem 2.4.12/2.5, every cell and quotation checked on the stated PDF page; customer counts are printed with the reports' thousands separators. Part D gives, for six top-level DNO posts in the consequences communications timeline, the time decoded from the post identifier and a short gist written for this exercise (post text neither reproduced nor closely paraphrased: no gist shares more than 3 consecutive words with its post; not openly licensed). The STATUS line scopes 'nothing synthesised' to Parts A-C. No value is synthesised.
